description: Add a fail-closed repository topology validation gate for nested git state, package ownership, generated artifacts, and wrapper assumptions.

support_scope.summary: Provides a deterministic local and PR-CI validator for nested Git state, unmanaged gitlinks, package-surface ownership, generated artifact drift, and explicit outer-wrapper checks.

gap_register.summary: The validator reports fail-closed diagnostics but intentionally does not rewrite Git topology or delete artifacts automatically.
